input: Find a local boxing gym for beginners

gold.taskTitle: Find a beginner-friendly local boxing gym
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to locate a boxing gym in their area that is suitable for beginners.

questions.title: What city or neighborhood should the search focus on?
questions.description: Identify the user's location to narrow down relevant gyms.

questions.title: How far are you willing to travel to the gym?
questions.description: Understand the maximum acceptable distance or commute time.

questions.title: What is your main goal for joining a boxing gym?
questions.description: Clarify whether the goal is fitness, self-defense, competition, or something else.

questions.title: Do you have a monthly budget in mind for membership?
questions.description: Determine any financial constraints that would filter gym options.

questions.title: Are there specific days or times you need classes?
questions.description: Understand scheduling needs to ensure the gym's timetable is compatible.

questions.title: Do you prefer a private trainer or group classes?
questions.description: Identify the preferred training format to match the right gym environment.

questions.title: Are there any physical limitations the gym should accommodate?
questions.description: Check for injuries, health conditions, or accessibility needs that affect gym suitability.
